name: @pipeworx/mcp-mfapi-india

tools.name: search_schemes
tools.description: Find Indian mutual-fund scheme codes by fund name. Fetches the full MFAPI scheme list (~16,000 schemes) and filters client-side by case-insensitive token match (every word in the query must appear in the scheme name, any order — so "SBI Bluechip" matches "SBI Blue Chip Fund"). This is the way to obtain a scheme_code for get_nav_history and latest_nav. Note: this call downloads the full list (~1-2MB). Keyless.

query.description: Fund-name fragment, e.g. "SBI Bluechip", "Parag Parikh", "index fund". Matched case-insensitively against scheme names.

tools.name: get_nav_history
tools.description: Get a mutual-fund scheme's NAV (net asset value) history from MFAPI — fund house, category, ISIN, latest NAV, and the most-recent NAV points (newest first). Use search_schemes to find a scheme_code first (e.g. 118550). Keyless.

scheme_code.description: AMFI scheme code, e.g. 118550. Get one from search_schemes.

limit.description: Number of most-recent NAV points to return (default 30, max 120).

tools.name: latest_nav
tools.description: Fast single-value lookup of a mutual-fund scheme's latest NAV (net asset value) from MFAPI. Returns the most recent NAV, its date, and basic scheme metadata. Use search_schemes to find a scheme_code first (e.g. 118550). Keyless.

scheme_code.description: AMFI scheme code, e.g. 118550. Get one from search_schemes.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mfapi-india forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mfapi-india pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
